comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
🚨 **BLOCKING: The auto-route gates the *resized* payload but uploads the *original* bytes — `images.maxBytesPerRequest` is bypassed and the mime/bytes pair can disagree**

The budget gate measures the processed (resized/converted) payload:

```dart
// builtin_tools_read.dart:348
if (processed.base64.length > budget) { ... }
```

but the vision request is built from the **raw file bytes**:

```dart
// builtin_tools_read.dart:358
final description = await describeImageWithVisionModel(
  visionConfig,
  bytes,               // ← original file bytes, NOT processed
  processed.mimeType,  // ← mime of the CONVERTED payload
  ...
```

`describeImageWithVisionModel` then sends `base64Encode(bytes)` (`inspect_image.dart`). `_processImage` resizes/re-encodes (BMP→PNG conversion, EXIF orientation baked, 0.75 shrink ladder) precisely when the original exceeds the inline limits — the common case for photos/screenshots. For such images:

1. **The budget gate is ineffective** — a 30 MB original whose shrunk inline payload is ~200 KB passes the gate and uploads a ~40 MB base64 blob to the vision provider, violating `images.maxBytesPerRequest` (the very knob the PR claims "applies to the auto-route call too"), with real spend/latency and provider-rejection risk.
2. **Mime/bytes mismatch** — a BMP converted to PNG inline is uploaded as raw BMP bytes labeled `image/png`; providers may reject or misdecode. The EXIF orientation the inline path bakes is also never applied to what the vision model sees.

Fix: send the processed payload so gate, mime, and body agree — e.g. thread the processed bytes out of `_processImage` (or `base64Decode(processed.base64)`) into the call. The AC6 degrade path already covers any residual provider failure.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
🚨 **BLOCKING: The resolvers never receive the main connection's key — the flagship `/models set vision|transcription <id>` flow resolves an EMPTY API key**

`resolveVisionSlotInspectConfig`/`resolveTranscriptionSlotConfig` support the gh-184 same-host main-key reuse (`mainBaseUrl`/`mainApiKey` → `resolveMediaSlotKey`), but the only production wiring — right here — passes just `resolveKey`, so `mainBaseUrl`/`mainApiKey` default to `''` and the same-host branch can never match.

That breaks the most common pin flow: `/models set vision <model>` writes a slot with **no `apiKeyName`** and `baseUrl` = the main endpoint (`provider_models.dart:_setModelsSlot`):

```
resolveMediaSlotKey → keyName null → _isSameHost(override.baseUrl, '') == false → key = ''
```

Result: `inspect_image`/`transcribe_audio` register **on** (the slot IS configured), and every call — including every image-read auto-route — fails with the provider's auth error. The "empty key is honest" rationale in the library docs covers slots whose named key genuinely can't resolve; here the main key **is** resolvable, and the established rule says same-host slots reuse it: `generate_image`/`generate_video` do exactly that for the identical slot shape via `MediaToolServices(mainApiKey: () => _apiKey, ...)` ("one rule, both CLI tools", gh-184 review). The new adapters are the exception, in the PR whose whole point is media-slot parity.

Fix: pass the main connection in scope (both variables already exist in `_runApp`):

```dart
return resolveVisionSlotInspectConfig(
  saved.models,
  mainBaseUrl: effective.baseUrl,
  mainApiKey: apiKey ?? '',
  resolveKey: resolveMediaSlotKeyName,
);
```

(same for `resolveTranscriptionSlotConfig`). The existing test "same-host slots reuse the main key when no apiKeyName is set" proves the mechanism — it just never fires in production today.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
🚨 **BLOCKING: The sqlite read swap drops the default /cost sink — after the swap, auto-route spend silently leaves /cost (AC2 regression)**

`AgentCli` applies the default sink at the services boundary (`agent_cli.dart:576`):

```dart
onImageInspectUsage:
    config.onImageInspectUsage ?? (usage) => _usage.addSideCall(usage),
```

so the initially registered `read` tool gets `_usage.addSideCall` when the host doesn't set `onImageInspectUsage` (the plain CLI never does). But this swap site — which rebuilds the SAME tool — reads the raw config field:

```dart
onImageUsage: config.onImageInspectUsage,  // null in the plain CLI
```

`_swapReadSqliteVariant` runs on every tool-availability refresh whose sqlite decision flips the variant, so in any session where it fires, the swapped `read` carries `onImageUsage: null` and every subsequent auto-route vision call is untracked — exactly what the gh-1984 AC2 wiring ("Auto-route spend joins /cost via `UsageAccumulator.addSideCall` … wired as the default sink in `AgentCli`") is supposed to guarantee.

The comment above already states the invariant for the resolver: "Both read-tool construction sites (wireAgentCore and the sqlite swap) must ride the SAME resolver." Apply the same hoist to the sink:

```dart
void Function(Usage usage)? get _readOnImageUsage =>
    config.onImageInspectUsage ?? (usage) => _usage.addSideCall(usage);
```

and pass `_readOnImageUsage` here (matching `_readVisionResolver` / `_readTranscribeAvailable`, which are already consistent).

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Tool registration stays boot-static while the read auto-route goes live — a mid-session `/models set` produces a mixed, misleading state**

The read auto-route re-resolves the vision slot per read (live), but the `inspect_image`/`transcribe_audio` capability decisions here still read the boot-frozen `config.visionConfig`/`config.transcribeConfig`:

```dart
'inspect_image': config.visionConfig != null ? on : const ToolCapability.absent(...)
```

After a mid-session `/models set vision <id>` (which the PR's design explicitly supports without a restart — the resolver closure picks it up on the next read):

- the read auto-route works, but `/tools` still shows `inspect_image` **off** with "no vision model configured — set models.slots.vision" — now false advice;
- with `images.autoInspect: false`, the omission note tells the agent "call inspect_image to describe this image" — a tool that is not registered in this session.

Suggestion: gate the capability on the same live resolver (a cached `bool Function()` like `_readTranscribeAvailable`, re-evaluated by the `rebuildToolAvailability()` pass that already re-reads scopes and re-applies availability), or at minimum reword the AC3 note/`/tools` hint to mention that the tool registers on restart when the boot config predates the slot.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: The per-read resolver reads `saved.models`, but `/models set` mutates `config.modelsConfig` — the two diverge when the config has no `models:` section**

The live-resolver design works because `AgentCliConfig.modelsConfig` is wired as `saved.models ?? ModelsConfig()` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart:1785`) and `/models set` mutates that shared object — when `saved.models` is non-null they are the same instance. But on a config with **no `models:` section** (fresh install), the CLI mutates a fresh `ModelsConfig()` while this resolver keeps reading `saved.models` (null) — a mid-session `/models set vision <id>` never reaches the auto-route, silently contradicting the "/models set edits apply without a restart" decision on exactly the machines that need guided setup the most.

Fix: resolve through the same source the CLI mutates, e.g. capture `saved.models ?? config.modelsConfig` in the closure (or thread a `ModelsConfig Function()` live accessor like the media tools' `modelsConfig:` seam). Line 1994 already shows the `cli.config.modelsConfig ?? saved.models` precedence — mirroring it here keeps one rule.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 **SUGGESTION: The shared vision helper now supports `cancelToken`/`onUsage` — wire them at the `inspect_image` call site and drop the pass-through wrapper**

`describeImageWithVisionModel` gained `cancelToken` (AC6) and `onUsage` (/cost), but the `inspect_image` tool's execute still calls the pass-through wrapper without either:

```dart
// inspect_image.dart:281
final description = await _inspectWithVisionModel(
  config,
  bytes,
  mimeType,
  prompt,
);
```

Two small parity wins, no behavior risk: forward `cancelToken: cancelToken` so a user cancel aborts a hung vision stream mid-flight (today only the pre-call checkpoints cancel), and forward `onUsage` if the tool's spend should be as visible as the auto-route's. With both wired, `_inspectWithVisionModel` (a pure forwarder since this PR) can be deleted entirely.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 **SUGGESTION: The `autoInspect` parameter is a test-only seam — document it as such**

No production caller passes `autoInspect` (host wiring relies on the process-global `imageRegistryConfig.autoInspect` published at boot); only `builtin_tools_test.dart` sets it. That's a fine fault-injection seam (same spirit as `builtinText`), but a one-line doc note — "test seam; production reads the boot-published `images.autoInspect` knob" — would prevent a future host from wiring it and accidentally forking from the process-global truth.

comments.body:
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST CHANGES

**Summary**: 4 blocking issues: the read auto-route gates the resized payload but uploads the original bytes (`images.maxBytesPerRequest` bypass + mime/bytes mismatch); the slot resolvers never receive the main connection's key, so the flagship `/models set vision|transcription <id>` flow authenticates with an empty key; the sqlite read swap drops the default `/cost` sink (AC2); and `.dmtools-target-workingdir` (local tool state, `.gitignore:171` says "never commit") was swept into the feature commit. 2 important (boot-static tool registration vs live slot resolution; `saved.models` vs `config.modelsConfig` divergence on fresh installs) and 2 suggestions — see inline threads.

**What looks good**: clean `dart analyze`; targeted suites green (367 tests); solid AC coverage in tests (auto-route, degrade, cancel, budget, live re-read, media notes, `addSideCall`); the main-connection opt-in exclusion and the app host's byte-identical read path are well reasoned and tested.

**Next steps**:
1. Send the processed image payload to the vision model so the budget gate, mime, and body agree (comment1)
2. Pass `mainBaseUrl`/`mainApiKey` from the `fah_runapp` resolvers — same-host main-key reuse (comment2)
3. Hoist the `/cost` sink default into a getter shared by both read-tool construction sites (comment3)
4. `git rm --cached .dmtools-target-workingdir` (comment4)
5. Align tool registration/`/tools` hints with the live resolver, or scope the claim to boot config (comment5)
6. Minor: resolver source on fresh installs, `inspect_image` cancel/usage parity, doc drift in `host_wiring_builder.dart:301` (still lists only `visionConfig, transcribeConfig` wiring)
